title: GDScript: Implement safe navigation operator (?.) for get, set, and call

milestone.title: 4.x
milestone.description: Issues and pull requests slated for an undetermined Godot 4 release.

body:
Description:
Implements the safe navigation operator (?.) in GDScript. This allows property get/set and method calls on null or freed objects to silently skip execution and evaluate to null instead of throwing a runtime error.

Implementation Details:

1) Parsing: Added tokenization and AST parsing for the ?. operator (represented via is_null_safe flags on nodes).

2) Opcodes: Introduced OPCODE_GET_NAMED_SAFE, OPCODE_SET_NAMED_SAFE, OPCODE_CALL_SAFE, and OPCODE_CALL_SAFE_RETURN to the GDScript bytecode schema (gdscript_function.h).

3) VM Logic: Modified `gdscript_vm.cpp` dispatch loop to handle the new safe opcodes. If the base object evaluates to Variant::NIL or is a previously freed instance (via is_instance_valid checks), the operation is skipped and a null Variant() is assigned to the destination address.

4) Code Generation: Added write_get_named_safe, write_set_named_safe, and write_call_safe to `gdscript_byte_codegen.cpp` and `gdscript_compiler.cpp` to route instructions when is_null_safe is detected.

5) Performance: The logic is isolated into distinct _SAFE opcodes instead of branching standard opcodes, maintaining zero performance loss for existing non-safe GDScript execution.

Example usage:
```
var node = get_node_or_null("Player")

# Safe Property Get / Set
var health = node?.health 
node?.health = 100 

# Safe Method Call
node?.queue_free() 

# Deep Chaining
var enemy_name = get_node_or_null("Target")?.get_parent()?.name
```

Works on https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/1902

(P.S. This PR has been intentionally converted to a draft to decouple the Runtime Execution from the Static Analyzer Architecture.
- Safe Navigation (?.) is Fully Operational: The core C++ VM opcodes, stack allocation, and runtime execution loops are complete and verified (Any other edge cases, if found, and suggestions are most welcome).
- The Elvis Operator (?:) Adding the null-coalescing fallback requires the engine to natively support internal nullable/union types (Type | Nil) within gdscript_analyzer.cpp making it a structural roadblock.)
